Editor lip flap._note: Fallback only: three mouth shapes swapped in the editor. Dialogue shots use Wan 2.2 14B by default.

Kling 4._note: Paid fallback for hero shots if the free test fails. Change a shot's model to this in shots.csv.

budget._note: Money caps. The free plan spends nothing; raise these only if you route shots to Kling 4.

kaggle._note: username: your Kaggle username. weekly_gpu_hours stays under Kaggle's ~30 h so a stuck run cannot use it all.

keyframe.negative_prompt: photorealistic, live action photo, flat sketch, text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, blurry

engines.negative_prompt: 色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走

video_weights._note: Real-ESRGAN anime-video model (BSD-3): built for frame-to-frame stability, so takes do not flicker.

image_weights._note: Real-CUGAN 3x (MIT) for stills. Community re-upload of the official weights; swap in your own copy if you prefer.

refs.negative_prompt: photorealistic photo, live action, flat sketch, text, watermark, logo, signature, extra fingers, deformed hands, blurry, lowres
refs._note: Qwen-Image-2512, Apache 2.0. If the GGUF repo is missing, the transformer is loaded in 4-bit instead.

fal._note: Paid fallback only. Endpoint ids are NOT verified; check each before a paid run.

refs._note: Gate 1: reference stills painted on Kaggle from style_bible/ref_prompts.json when style_bible/refs/ lacks them.

modal._note: Second free GPU backend. Starter plan: $30 of compute a month; with no payment method Modal cannot bill. usd_per_hour counts the L4 ($0.80) plus 4 CPU cores and 48 GiB memory (about $0.57) that each batch reserves. monthly_cap_usd stays under $30 so the pipeline stops itself first. Do not raise it, and do not add a payment method on Modal.
